title: A new frontend for pollinations.ai
summary:
A rebuilt site frontend and a cleaner app directory led the day, alongside clearer subscription details and more honest model-health numbers.

Merged a themeable replacement frontend that brings the theme creator, image playground, app directory, community page and docs together. A grayscale preset was added, the plants preset got a shorter name, and the contributors section gained a repository link.

Consolidated 318 app listings into one date-sorted directory, which supplies the Apps page and the README’s recent-app list. Submission review gained clearer summaries and checks, while a workflow fix lets issue-form submissions create PRs again.

The project galleries added BhaujAI for business and creator tasks, Asive AI for coding and chat, and Multi Image Generator for side-by-side image-model comparisons.

highlights.title: A themeable site frontend
highlights.text: The replacement pollinations.ai frontend brings the theme creator, image playground, app directory, community page and docs together. [Explore pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai).
